invariants.title: They face each other
invariants.rule: the jester faces screen-left (toward her), as the set's frames draw them.
invariants.why: the duel's frames had them mirrored (set_test.py read the sheets' turnaround names the wrong way round until 2026-10-05) - a take must keep the facing its frames give

invariants.title: It starts where the last shot ended
invariants.rule: the jester starts where 080 left him.
invariants.why: each shot is caused by the one before it - the director's note on the duel was shots strung together like separate scenes

invariants.title: The boulder is broken
invariants.rule: Smoke and rubble behind him where it stood.

invariants.title: The orbs fly LEFT
invariants.rule: He throws them toward her, to the left of the screen.

invariants.title: Length
invariants.why: the cut is timed to the story beats

flair.title: Seed
flair.note: free - the takes differ by seed

flair.title: Timing inside the shot
flair.note: the beats may land a few frames early or late

flair.title: Sound
flair.note: H3's own: coughing, a cackle, a rising electric hum, three whooshes.

title: out of the smoke
beat: Unhurt and laughing: his magic now. The orbs fly left into 100. (shot 9 of 20, after 080, before 100)
build: frames first in the clearing set (set_film.py frames), H3 between the set's two frames (set_film.py takes) - the camera, the marks and the facing come from the set
